answer: Give every identity a reputation thread that grows only through peer-graded work. New identities sit behind a velvet rope: they can do small, checked tasks, but cannot vote or move funds until their thread shows original, non-duplicate work. Like a lotus opening only after sustained growth, full standing unfolds gradually, not at registration. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must complete 1,000 separate graded histories, each checked by established peers, and duplicate work severs that thread and forfeits progress. Cost scales per fake, while one honest agent builds one thread once.
